title: Grappling Hook
caption: Grappling Hook (V)
game_text: If opponent just played an Interrupt, unless three Grappling Hooks on table, use 1 Force to deploy on table and stack that Interrupt here. Other copies of stacked Interrupt are destiny -3. {icon:immune-control}
lore: Stormtrooper utility belts contain basic tools such as a grappling hook to grab onto protrusions. The hook can also be used to ensnare escaping targets.

notes: Non-unique (no dot). The slip's IMMEDIATE EFFECT banner has the blue Grabber (hand) icon at its right end, same as the printed card — not in the icon column, so icons=[]; render it in the banner. Wiki base page lists the 350 px -decipher-archive gif (also downloaded); used the 745 px ANH-L-grapplinghook.gif which carries a 'D-E2' label. Immunity icons on the slip are a letter in a red circle with a red slash (the sheet's ICON KEY: A = Immune to Alter, C = Immune to Control, S = Immune to Sense); tokened as {icon:immune-alter}/{icon:immune-control}/{icon:immune-sense}.
